text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Hero...
text_block_list.text:
Reporters had gathered at the summer 
training camp.
Their target seemed to be a 
promising Junior-class Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Hero...
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy spots a line in an article 
covering "her." Written there was the 
following:

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Hero...
text_block_list.text:
"The day will surely come when people
call 
her this." ――"A hero."
